meta.model_usage: display_only; does not feed Model A or CBB game projections
meta.ranking_policy: Model order only; no manual team rearrangement and no poll input.
meta.uncertainty_note: Adjacent ranks outside the elite tier are not materially distinct when rating gaps are small.
meta.feature_policy: Prior opponent-adjusted efficiency, verified returning minutes, recruiting and transfer production. Conference identity is not a model feature.
meta.historical_timing_limitation: Historical personnel archives are reproducible but not certified snapshots of their original preseason publication dates; official promotion remains blocked.
meta.test_status: The 2026 holdout has now been analyzed and is no longer untouched. A later season is required for fresh confirmation.

validation.overlap_interpretation: Descriptive only. End-of-season top-25 membership is not the preseason power-rating target and is not a promotion criterion.

out_of_time_test.overlap_interpretation: Descriptive only. End-of-season top-25 membership is not the preseason power-rating target and is not a promotion criterion.

roster_power_display_out_of_time_test.overlap_interpretation: Descriptive only. End-of-season top-25 membership is not the preseason power-rating target and is not a promotion criterion.

promotion_blockers: Historical personnel snapshots are not point-in-time certified.

prospective_protocol.target: game-level scoring margin for Division I versus Division I games
prospective_protocol.primary_comparison: paired absolute-error difference versus the frozen production baseline
prospective_protocol.versioning_rule: Any parameter or input-rule change creates a new candidate and starts a new prospective clock.
